title: स्थानीय सरकारमा सुशासन : अवसर र चुनौती
nepali: राज्य संयन्त्रलाई जनमुखी बनाई राज्य प्रणालीमा सरोकारवालाहरूको सक्रिय एवं सार्थक सहभागिताका साथै राज्यबाट उपलब्ध गराउने सेवालाई छिटो छरितो, र प्रभावकारी बनाई राज्य र जनताबिच नजिकको सम्बन्ध स्थापित हुनुलाई नै सुशासन भनिन्छ । जहाँ कानुनको पूर्ण परिपालना, दण्डहीनताको अन्त्य, जनमुखी एवम् पारदर्शी सरकार, भ्रष्टाचार रहित समाज रहेको हुन्छ । सुशासन सबै तहको प्राथमिकताको क्षेत्र हो । स्थानीय तहमा सुशासनको अवस्थाको बारेमा जानकारी लिन र सुशासनको सन्दर्भमा नीतिगत व्यवस्था र कार्यान्वयनको अवस्था बीचको लेखाजोखा गर्ने प्रयोजनको लागि द्वितयिक स्रोतमा आधारित भइ तयार पारिएको यसलेखमा विशेष गरी दोलखा जिल्लाका विभिन्न स्थानीय तहमा गरिएकोस्थानीय तह संस्थागत क्षमता स्वमूल्याङ्कन प्रतिवेदनमा आधारित भइ यो लेख तयार गरिएको छ । सो सम्बन्धमा जानकार भएका व्यक्तिहरूको सल्लाह सुझावलाई पनि अधार मानिएको छ । दोलखा जिल्लाको स्थानीय तहलाई आधार मानी गरिएको स्वमूल्याङ्कन अनुसार शैलुङ गाउँपालिका पहिलो (८९.५ प्रतिशत) र दोस्रोमा भीमेश्वर नगरपालिका (७३.५८ प्रतिशत) रहेको देखिन्छ । सबैभन्दा कम अङ्क प्राप्त गर्नेमा बैतेश्वर गाउँपालिका (४६.४ प्रतिशत) रहेको छ । सूचकगत अवस्था हेर्दा सबैभन्दा राम्रो न्यायिक समिति अन्तर्गतका सूचकको अवस्था देखिन्छ भने सेवा प्रवाहको सूचकको अवस्था पनि ठिकै रहेकोदेखिन्छ । विशेषगरी समन्वयको क्षेत्रमा सबै स्थानीय तहको सूचकको अवस्था सुधार गर्नु पर्ने, सहभागितात्मक योजना तर्जुमा प्रक्रिया अवलम्बन गर्नुपर्ने, सार्वजनिक सुनुवाई जस्ता पारदर्शिताका अभ्यासलाई नियमितता दिनुपर्ने, क्षमता विकास योजना तयारी र कार्यान्वयन गर्ने र प्रतिवेदन प्रणालीलाई संस्थागत गराउनु पर्ने देखिन्छ ।
american_english: Good governance is said to be the establishment of a close relationship between the state and the people by making the state machinery people-oriented, together with the active and meaningful participation of stakeholders in the state system, and by making the services provided by the state quick, streamlined and effective. Where there is full compliance with the law, an end to impunity, a people-oriented and transparent government, and a society free of corruption. Good governance is a priority area at every level. This article, prepared on the basis of secondary sources for the purpose of gathering information about the state of good governance at the local level and of assessing the policy arrangements and implementation status in the context of good governance, is based in particular on the local-level institutional capacity self-assessment report conducted in various local levels of Dolakha district, and this article has been prepared on that basis. The advice and suggestions of people knowledgeable about that matter have also been taken as a basis. According to the self-assessment carried out taking the local levels of Dolakha district as the basis, Shailung Rural Municipality ranks first (89.5 percent) and Bhimeshwar Municipality ranks second (73.58 percent). The lowest scorer is Baiteshwor Rural Municipality (46.4 percent). Looking at the indicator-wise status, the status of the indicators under the judicial committee appears to be the best, while the status of the service delivery indicator also appears to be fairly satisfactory. In particular, it appears necessary to improve the status of indicators of all local levels in the area of coordination, to adopt a participatory planning formulation process, to regularize transparency practices such as public hearings, to prepare and implement capacity development plans, and to institutionalize the reporting system.

informal_english: So good governance is basically about making the state machinery people-friendly, with stakeholders genuinely involved and participating in a meaningful way, and getting state services delivered quickly, smoothly and effectively, so that a close relationship builds up between the state and the people. That's where you've got full compliance with the law, an end to impunity, a people-focused and transparent government, and a society without corruption. Good governance is a priority area at every level, by the way. This article was put together from secondary sources to get a handle on how good governance is tracking at the local level and to weigh up the policy setup against how it's actually being implemented; it leans especially on the local-level institutional capacity self-assessment report done across various local levels in Dolakha district, and the article itself was prepared on that basis. The advice and suggestions of people in the know on that front were also taken on board. Going by the self-assessment that took the local levels of Dolakha district as its basis, Shailung Rural Municipality came first (89.5 per cent) and Bhimeshwar Municipality second (73.58 per cent). The lowest scorer was Baiteshwor Rural Municipality (46.4 per cent). Looking at the indicator-by-indicator picture, the indicators under the judicial committee look the best, while the service delivery indicator is pretty decent too. In particular, it looks like all local levels need to lift their game in coordination, adopt a participatory planning process, make transparency practices like public hearings a regular thing, put together and carry out capacity development plans, and get the reporting system properly institutionalised.
